User.title: User
User.description: User profile representation stored in Firestore

id.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

countryCode.description: International dialing code of the user (e.g. +91, +1)

countryIso.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. IN, US, GB)

fullPhoneNumber.description: Formatted international phone number with country calling code

role.description: The system role of the user

status.description: Account status of the client user

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was last updated

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Service request or booking submitted by a client

id.description: The unique document ID for the booking

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who made the booking

phone.description: Contact phone number for the booking

serviceName.description: The requested service from the 14 service catalog options

deadline.description: Target completion date for the task

status.description: Current status of the booking or request

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the booking was created

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user profiles accessible by the owner and admins

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User specific projects isolated by Firebase UID

/users/{userId}/requests/{requestId}.description: User specific task requests isolated by Firebase UID

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: User specific direct messaging isolated by Firebase UID

/users/{userId}/payments/{paymentId}.description: User specific payments isolated by Firebase UID

/users/{userId}/quotations/{quotationId}.description: User specific quotations isolated by Firebase UID

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: User specific alerts and notifications isolated by Firebase UID

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Service requests and task bookings created by authenticated clients
